name: Pan-Zoom to Next Node
easing: zoom EASE.inOut f20-30 to 1.2x; pan EASE.inOut f30-54; zoom-out f54-76 back to 1.0 centered
bestFor: Moving attention from one node to the next on an infinite-canvas feel.
keyframeTable: camera on right node, starting to zoom out
rest: camera 1.0, both nodes inside safe frame
script: Two nodes with an arrow build. The camera zooms to 1.2x on the left node, pans to the right (orange) node, then zooms out so both rest inside the safe frame.
